source: Stylesheet rules in 2e9a6afac7e3a0d9.css, read from the live page. A full motion-probe.mjs pass was not run. The preview browser could not produce screenshot frames, and a separate headless session was not started against login.
documentFonts: Matter normal 100-1000 status loaded on /musicmakers. Oblique face unloaded.
reducedMotion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .motion-safe\:scroll-smooth { scroll-behavior: smooth }; .motion-safe\:transition-opacity { transition-property: opacity; transition-duration: .15s } }

transitions.nav: transition-all duration-300 ease-in (Tailwind classes on the marketing nav)

gap: Computed transition lists per element, and a second pass under emulated prefers-reduced-motion, were not taken. The reduce verdict is therefore a gap, not a finding that the product ignores the setting.
